page: Microsoft Azure L64aos_v5 is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Laosv5 server family. Powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A defining characteristic of this server is its massive local storage capacity of 46,080 GB. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance Azure storage options. It does not include any integrated GPUs, making it strictly a CPU-driven resource. Additionally, it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the combination of 64 dedicated AMD vCPUs, 512.0 GB of RAM, and 46,080 GB of local storage, the L64aos_v5 is engineered for data-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale relational and non-relational databases, big data analytics, data warehousing, and enterprise applications requiring high-capacity local storage and substantial memory footprints.
